correctness.rationale: For n>=2, exact Dirichlet-simplex exceedance integration gives E[M Q] with evaluated beta integrals. Two finite binomial identities reduce it to harmonic numbers. Independent marginal Dirichlet fourth moments give Var(Q), maximal-spacing tail moments give Var(M), and (H-1)^2+(H2-1)>0 establishes strict positivity. Harmonic asymptotics prove the rate. The standalone standard-library rational script passes n=2..80 and independently integrates n=2 and n=3; finite checks are corroborative only. Boundary n=1 has zero variances and undefined correlation.

value.rationale: Longest uniform gap and Greenwood quadratic spacing sum are natural, different uniformity-test diagnostics. Exact finite-sample cross calibration and covariance sign for every n, plus the sharp log-squared over root-n correlation decay, characterize simultaneous use of these tests. This is a motivated global dependence law rather than a selected arbitrary numerical instance; no independence, power optimality or complete joint law is claimed.
